text:
amanda: 20-min grooming in 10. Post-launch items: small UI polish bundle, a streaming perf regression, a rare 502 on dedicated routing, and two non-urgent asks (rollout toggle, token telemetry). Need to decide hotpatch vs next sprint.

reza: Please paste the QA notes + effort. We'll triage by customer impact and rollback risk.

amanda: QA notes: 6 defects — 4 UI (modal layout, empty-state copy, primary button focus ring, mobile overflow), 1 routing 502 (intermittent), 1 embedding tokenization mismatch. Enhancements: canary toggle + token-breakdown telemetry. Estimates: UI ~1 dev-day if CSS/strings only; routing/perf unknown but potentially urgent; enhancements next sprint.

ben: If streaming path is regressing it could hit many customers. I'll triage traces now. Any staging repro?

lia: UX note: issues are in onboarding flow; visible but no data loss. I can scope fixes to be presentational to keep risk low. Will add quick a11y check.

reza: Proposal: (1) Hotpatch routing + streaming perf if triage indicates config/regression (owner: ben). (2) Canary the 4 UI fixes if low-risk (owner: lia + FE). (3) Schedule toggle + telemetry next sprint. Anyone object?

lia: +1. I'll prepare screenshot diffs and a short QA checklist.

ben: Starting traces. Hypothesis: KV cache invalidation or kernel selection change for longer sequences. If it's config we can hotpatch in hours; kernel/model-level needs gated rollout. Also remind ops to redact token-level logs during canary.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for branch "onboard-ui-fixes" at 15:30 UTC — awaiting approvals.

amanda: Plan set. I'll update tickets (hotpatch/ship, next-sprint, needs-design) and include rollback steps. Scheduling a 15-min stand in 10 to confirm owners and verification steps.

marta: I can reproduce the routing 502 with the repro steps locally; will run full regression after canary and report.

amanda: Thanks all — will post ticket numbers after the call.
